verdict: Partial assessment with 3 confirmed defects in destination filtering, account preferences, and listing asset delivery.

findings.title: Penang destination search path returns HTTP 503
findings.severity_rationale: Core browse filter option fails and blocks destination results.
findings.priority_rationale: Direct user-visible outage in a primary discovery flow.
findings.impact: Users cannot browse Penang stays when selecting destination filter.
findings.expected_basis: Penang is provided as a selectable destination and appears in all-destinations listing.
findings.actual: Results unavailable alert with HTTP 503 and reference shown.
possible_causes: Destination-specific backend dependency for Penang is unavailable.
Filter query path is not handling Penang data source failures gracefully.
findings.recommendation: Investigate backend availability for destination-specific query path and add graceful fallback behavior for transient failures.

findings.title: Account Travel preferences endpoint fails on load and retry
findings.severity_rationale: Authenticated account section is unavailable due repeated server errors.
findings.priority_rationale: Breaks expected account functionality for signed-in users.
findings.impact: Users cannot view or update travel preferences.
findings.expected: Preferences content loads on initial request or retry.
findings.expected_basis: Feature is explicitly linked in account sections and includes retry affordance.
findings.actual: HTTP 500 shown on initial load and retry with unique references.
possible_causes: Unhandled server exception during preferences read operation.
Missing preference record path lacks null-safe handling.
findings.recommendation: Inspect server logs using UI reference IDs, add resilient handling for missing preference data, and cover retry path in integration tests.

findings.title: Rimba Terrace listing image asset path returns HTTP 500
findings.severity_rationale: Visual content degradation impacts listing quality but does not fully block booking flows.
findings.priority_rationale: User-facing quality issue with direct asset delivery failure.
findings.impact: Rimba Terrace card renders with a failed image request, reducing trust and polish.
steps: Load discover page with all destinations.
Inspect Rimba Terrace card image request in network logs.
findings.expected: Image request succeeds with valid asset.
findings.expected_basis: Listing cards should provide valid imagery like other cards.
possible_causes: Incorrect asset path configured for Rimba Terrace.
Missing static file or broken static asset mapping in server.
findings.recommendation: Correct listing image path and add static-asset validation checks in CI to detect missing media files.
